meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入分子结构,快速预测毒性、成药性等性质
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要快速做分子性质预测实验,又不想自己搭特征工程
copy.tagline_en: Predict molecular properties like toxicity and drug-likeness from structures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want quick molecular property predictions without building featurization yourself

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能加载分子数据(SMILES、SDF 等),做指纹或图特征化,训练传统 ML 或图神经网络模型,并在 MoleculeNet 基准上预测分子性质如毒性、溶解度。
howto.when: 当你要求做分子性质预测(ADMET、毒性等)、加载分子结构数据文件,或跑 MoleculeNet 基准时触发。

say.text: 用 Delaney 数据训练并评估一个溶解度预测模型
在 Tox21 上训练一个 GCN 模型并评估
用 ChemBERTa 在小数据上做迁移学习微调

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can load molecular data (SMILES, SDF, FASTA), featurize it into fingerprints or graphs, train traditional ML or GNN models, and run MoleculeNet benchmarks to predict properties such as toxicity or solubility.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask for molecular property prediction (ADMET, toxicity), need to load molecular structure files, or want to run MoleculeNet benchmarks.

say_en.text: Train and evaluate a solubility model on the Delaney dataset
Train a GCN model on Tox21 and evaluate it
Fine-tune ChemBERTa on my small dataset
